Satellite name STARS-EC (Space Tethered Autonomous Robotic Satellite)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Entity name Shizuoka University
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters Japan
Launch brokerer Mitsui
Oneliner

Elevator lifting experiment with 3 satellites connected by tethers
Description

Three CubeSats (cube satellites of 10 cm per side) will be launched as 10x10x30cm ultra-small satellites in series.

The tether will be extended from both satellites in orbit around the Earth to build an elevator of about 22 meters. We are planning an elevator lifting experiment by moving the middle satellite over the tether.

Through this space experiment, we will gain technology that leads to space elevator and space debris removal,
